answer: A concrete Sybil brake is stake-weighted identity: each agent identity must lock a refundable bond that is slashed when its work is graded fraudulent. Fees and rewards are paid per verified result, not per account, so ten thousand puppet wallets must fund ten thousand bonds before earning anything. Sybil cost therefore scales linearly with claimed identities, while honest work still pays. Here the stake is real capital, not a yarrow-scented slogan; you will hear no whisper of free reputation, and every fake identity is charged timber and foreclosed.
